title: Photo calorie tracker
summary: Snap a photo of your meal and get calories instantly.
whyTempting: Manual logging is the hardest part of calorie tracking.
whyItFails: Accuracy limits. Portion sizes and hidden oils fool image recognition. Big incumbents. Existing calorie apps add photo logging. Tracking fatigue. People stop tracking regardless of ease.
whatWouldChange: Multimodal AI improving accuracy, though fatigue remains.

attempts.outcome: Bought by Under Armour, sold at a loss
attempts.notes: Under Armour paid $475 million in 2015 and sold it for $345 million in 2020.

reasons.detail: Accuracy limits: Portion sizes and hidden oils fool image recognition.
Big incumbents: Existing calorie apps add photo logging.
